requirement:
During coverage-data preparation, on a terminal enabled under
{cite}`requirements.test-coverage.processes.progress.terminal`, Habeas MUST
display updating activity and identify the current preparation stage.
rationale:
The tests adequately check `requirements.test-coverage.processes.progress.preparation`.

Obligations derived from the requirement:
1. On an enabled terminal, preparation displays updating activity.
2. On an enabled terminal, preparation identifies the current preparation stage.

The terminal-enablement policy and clearing behavior belong to the cited `requirements.test-coverage.processes.progress.terminal`. That requirement is context only.

Coverage:
- **Stage identification, unit level:** `src/execution_coverage/progress.rs#mod[tests]/fn[stage_and_conversion_counts_are_visible_then_cleared]` builds a preparation `Progress` over a recording terminal. It asserts that the initial stage text ("Recording inputs") is drawn. After `stage(...)` it asserts that the new stage text ("Capturing coverage maps") is drawn. It also asserts that the display clears on drop.
- **Stage identification, end to end:** `tests/execution_coverage.rs#fn[coverage_progress_on_a_pty_preserves_reports_and_plain_output_policy]` runs the real binary on a PTY with `TERM=xterm`. It asserts that stderr contains both "Preparing coverage: recording inputs" and "Preparing coverage: capturing maps". Those are the two stages `Progress::preparation()` and `runner.rs#fn[run]` set, via `progress.stage`. The same test checks the stage is cleared on a preparation failure.
- **Updating activity:** `src/execution_coverage/progress.rs#mod[tests]/fn[preparation_activity_keeps_updating_without_a_stage_change]` creates a preparation display and never changes the stage. It polls the recorded frames for up to 2 seconds and asserts that at least two distinct frames containing the stage text appear. Every such frame must contain the elapsed-time marker. This shows the display updates through the steady tick without a stage change. The PTY test also asserts that escape sequences appear, so the display updates in place.

Gaps considered:
- An implementation that drew the stage once and never updated would fail the activity test.
- An implementation that omitted a stage name would fail the PTY assertions.
- I found no untested obligation and no missing `{test}` marking. All three tests carry `{test}` references to the subject.

text: During coverage-data preparation, on a terminal enabled under
display updating activity and identify the current preparation stage.
Habeas coverage progress MUST be displayed when stderr is an interactive
terminal and `TERM` is not `dumb`. `NO_COLOR` MUST disable color without
disabling progress. When stderr is redirected or `TERM=dumb`, Habeas coverage
progress MUST NOT emit animation or terminal control sequences.
Temporary progress displays MUST be cleared when their stage ends, including
empty work and early collection failures. Final diagnostics and the coverage
artifact location MUST remain readable. Progress reporting MUST NOT change
coverage results, retained profiles, or command exit status.
